sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext: ;The Most Brutal Student At the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Rassimov]] reports to [[the Betrayer]], who can be seen sitting on a throne at the top of some stairs. Molten grey liquid overflows from cauldrons on either side of the Betrayer and flows down the stairs towards Rassimov. Rassimov glows with power and cries out in pain, during which the Betrayer apparently speaks to him, asking that he increase the number of [[Blood Spiral]] members. Rassimov agrees. He is then interrupted by [[Shauna]], [[Wind]], [[Tantras]], and [[Kiel]], who tell him that [[Stack]] wishes to join the Brotherhood. Rassimov at first commands them to destroy Stack, but changes mind upon hearing that Stack will give them the [[Titan]] [[Medusa]] as proof of his allegiance. Tantras suggests sending Kiel, as he is powerful enough that he can defeat the Organization even if it is a trap, and Rassimov agrees. ;Fighting Wilder Still unsettled by the visions of [[Arc]], the Huntik team are all feeling down as they travel by boat to [[Medusa's Island]]. They arrive to discover [[Wilder]]. [[Hoffman]] and the [[Suits]] waiting on the beach. Wilder smugly reveals that with Stack infiltrating the Blood Spiral, he can control them from the inside. Realizing Wilder won't be convinced to help them fight the Spiral, [[Dante]] invokes [[Caliban]] to fight [[Venomaster]] and [[Myrmidon]] while [[Lok]] invokes [[Kipperin]]. While the rest of the team fights the [[Organization]], Zhalia tracks down Stack, who leads Kiel and some Blood Spiral members to [[Medusa's Cave]]. She decides to report back to her team once she reaches the cave instead of infiltrating it. Lok battles with [[Wilder]] but is sent crashing to ground when [[Kipperin]] is hit by a [[Weakenshade]] spell. Wilder sees an opportunity to get his hands on the [[Willblade]] but is interrupted by Dante. Wilder summons [[Incubane]] who fights Caliban and [[Sabriel]]. [[Cherit]] defeats Incubane with an energy blast while Lok and Dante hit Wilder together, defeating him. Reluctant to leave Stack and ruin their plan, Wilder angrily vows that they'll meet again some day before withdrawing with his men. ;Ambushing Kiel Stack uses [[Divine Mirror Kagami]] as his secret weapon to defeat [[Medusa]] but she proves harder to contain than anticipated. The team comes up with a plan to capture Kiel, using [[Dendras]] to neutralize his [[Titan]], [[Vulcana]] and [[Metagolem]] to restrain Kiel. The plan is abruptly ruined however by [[Marduk]] and some [[Casterwill Hunters]] inside the cave who the team were unaware of. Lok summons [[Baselaird]] to fight off the [[Harlekin]]s but they are isolated by Vulcana. [[Sophie]] recognizes [[Kiel]] as they fight while Dante tells Lok that it's up to him to finish the mission. Cherit and Zhalia help Lok solve the puzzle of the Gorgon sisters, chasing the light to his orb to to recover Medusa's [[Amulet]]. Baselaird defeats Vulcana by grabbing her so that he can hit her but her hot flames send him back his Amulet too. Zhalia's [[Thoughtspecter]] illusions give the team time to escape from Kiel who angrily knocks Stack unconscious and tells his men that they will return to Tantras. ;Zhalia's Exit Sophie is unsettled after her encounter with Kiel and reckons she has met him before. Zhalia's confidence is shaken by the realization her failure to use her skills as a spy is what caused the team to be endangered. She comes to the conclusion that to defeat the Blood Spiral each of the team will have to focus on what they do best, and as she is a best at being a spy, for her that means infiltrating the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. She arranges to contact the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team while she is acting as a double agent using a journal that has been connected by [[Logosbook]] spell to one that she gives to Dante, which will allow Dante to read in his journal what she writes in her journal, then says her goodbyes to the team.
sections.text:
The Most Brutal Student
At the Blood Spiral Base, Rassimov reports to the Betrayer, who can be seen sitting on a throne at the top of some stairs. Molten grey liquid overflows from cauldrons on either side of the Betrayer and flows down the stairs towards Rassimov. Rassimov glows with power and cries out in pain, during which the Betrayer apparently speaks to him, asking that he increase the number of Blood Spiral members. Rassimov agrees. He is then interrupted by Shauna, Wind, Tantras, and Kiel, who tell him that Stack wishes to join the Brotherhood. Rassimov at first commands them to destroy Stack, but changes mind upon hearing that Stack will give them the Titan Medusa as proof of his allegiance. Tantras suggests sending Kiel, as he is powerful enough that he can defeat the Organization even if it is a trap, and Rassimov agrees.

Fighting Wilder
Still unsettled by the visions of Arc, the Huntik team are all feeling down as they travel by boat to Medusa's Island. They arrive to discover Wilder. Hoffman and the Suits waiting on the beach. Wilder smugly reveals that with Stack infiltrating the Blood Spiral, he can control them from the inside. Realizing Wilder won't be convinced to help them fight the Spiral, Dante invokes Caliban to fight Venomaster and Myrmidon while Lok invokes Kipperin. While the rest of the team fights the Organization, Zhalia tracks down Stack, who leads Kiel and some Blood Spiral members to Medusa's Cave. She decides to report back to her team once she reaches the cave instead of infiltrating it.

Lok battles with Wilder but is sent crashing to ground when Kipperin is hit by a Weakenshade spell. Wilder sees an opportunity to get his hands on the Willblade but is interrupted by Dante. Wilder summons Incubane who fights Caliban and Sabriel. Cherit defeats Incubane with an energy blast while Lok and Dante hit Wilder together, defeating him. Reluctant to leave Stack and ruin their plan, Wilder angrily vows that they'll meet again some day before withdrawing with his men.

Ambushing Kiel
Stack uses Divine Mirror Kagami as his secret weapon to defeat Medusa but she proves harder to contain than anticipated. The team comes up with a plan to capture Kiel, using Dendras to neutralize his Titan, Vulcana and Metagolem to restrain Kiel. The plan is abruptly ruined however by Marduk and some Casterwill Hunters inside the cave who the team were unaware of. Lok summons Baselaird to fight off the Harlekins but they are isolated by Vulcana. Sophie recognizes Kiel as they fight while Dante tells Lok that it's up to him to finish the mission.

Cherit and Zhalia help Lok solve the puzzle of the Gorgon sisters, chasing the light to his orb to to recover Medusa's Amulet. Baselaird defeats Vulcana by grabbing her so that he can hit her but her hot flames send him back his Amulet too. Zhalia's Thoughtspecter illusions give the team time to escape from Kiel who angrily knocks Stack unconscious and tells his men that they will return to Tantras.

Zhalia's Exit
Sophie is unsettled after her encounter with Kiel and reckons she has met him before. Zhalia's confidence is shaken by the realization her failure to use her skills as a spy is what caused the team to be endangered. She comes to the conclusion that to defeat the Blood Spiral each of the team will have to focus on what they do best, and as she is a best at being a spy, for her that means infiltrating the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. She arranges to contact the Huntik team while she is acting as a double agent using a journal that has been connected by Logosbook spell to one that she gives to Dante, which will allow Dante to read in his journal what she writes in her journal, then says her goodbyes to the team.

full_text:
Paris, France

When the Ring of Arc vanishes, Lok, Dante, Sophie, and Zhalia head into the Catacombs to find it. However, the Ring is actually the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc. She traps each Seeker inside a dream world they must escape. The Huntik team manages to defeat Arc, but Dante's dream leaves him worried about the future.

Synopsis

The Huntik team must race the Organization and a new team of Blood Spiral Casterwill Hunters, led by the explosive Kiel, to recover the dangerous Titan Medusa. However, the mission soon takes a drastic turn, forcing Zhalia to adopt a new plan.

Plot

The Most Brutal Student
At the Blood Spiral Base, Rassimov reports to the Betrayer, who can be seen sitting on a throne at the top of some stairs. Molten grey liquid overflows from cauldrons on either side of the Betrayer and flows down the stairs towards Rassimov. Rassimov glows with power and cries out in pain, during which the Betrayer apparently speaks to him, asking that he increase the number of Blood Spiral members. Rassimov agrees. He is then interrupted by Shauna, Wind, Tantras, and Kiel, who tell him that Stack wishes to join the Brotherhood. Rassimov at first commands them to destroy Stack, but changes mind upon hearing that Stack will give them the Titan Medusa as proof of his allegiance. Tantras suggests sending Kiel, as he is powerful enough that he can defeat the Organization even if it is a trap, and Rassimov agrees.

Fighting Wilder
Still unsettled by the visions of Arc, the Huntik team are all feeling down as they travel by boat to Medusa's Island. They arrive to discover Wilder. Hoffman and the Suits waiting on the beach. Wilder smugly reveals that with Stack infiltrating the Blood Spiral, he can control them from the inside. Realizing Wilder won't be convinced to help them fight the Spiral, Dante invokes Caliban to fight Venomaster and Myrmidon while Lok invokes Kipperin. While the rest of the team fights the Organization, Zhalia tracks down Stack, who leads Kiel and some Blood Spiral members to Medusa's Cave. She decides to report back to her team once she reaches the cave instead of infiltrating it.

Lok battles with Wilder but is sent crashing to ground when Kipperin is hit by a Weakenshade spell. Wilder sees an opportunity to get his hands on the Willblade but is interrupted by Dante. Wilder summons Incubane who fights Caliban and Sabriel. Cherit defeats Incubane with an energy blast while Lok and Dante hit Wilder together, defeating him. Reluctant to leave Stack and ruin their plan, Wilder angrily vows that they'll meet again some day before withdrawing with his men.

Ambushing Kiel
Stack uses Divine Mirror Kagami as his secret weapon to defeat Medusa but she proves harder to contain than anticipated. The team comes up with a plan to capture Kiel, using Dendras to neutralize his Titan, Vulcana and Metagolem to restrain Kiel. The plan is abruptly ruined however by Marduk and some Casterwill Hunters inside the cave who the team were unaware of. Lok summons Baselaird to fight off the Harlekins but they are isolated by Vulcana. Sophie recognizes Kiel as they fight while Dante tells Lok that it's up to him to finish the mission.

Cherit and Zhalia help Lok solve the puzzle of the Gorgon sisters, chasing the light to his orb to to recover Medusa's Amulet. Baselaird defeats Vulcana by grabbing her so that he can hit her but her hot flames send him back his Amulet too. Zhalia's Thoughtspecter illusions give the team time to escape from Kiel who angrily knocks Stack unconscious and tells his men that they will return to Tantras.

Zhalia's Exit
Sophie is unsettled after her encounter with Kiel and reckons she has met him before. Zhalia's confidence is shaken by the realization her failure to use her skills as a spy is what caused the team to be endangered. She comes to the conclusion that to defeat the Blood Spiral each of the team will have to focus on what they do best, and as she is a best at being a spy, for her that means infiltrating the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. She arranges to contact the Huntik team while she is acting as a double agent using a journal that has been connected by Logosbook spell to one that she gives to Dante, which will allow Dante to read in his journal what she writes in her journal, then says her goodbyes to the team.

Production Errors

• In the French dub, all of Wilder's lines from 9:18 to 9:41 are silent, most likely due to an editing error or to the voice actor not being available.

He is then interrupted by Shauna, Wind, Tantras, and Kiel, who tell him that Stack wishes to join the Brotherhood. Rassimov at first commands them to destroy Stack, but changes mind upon hearing that Stack will give them the Titan Medusa as proof of his allegiance. Tantras suggests sending Kiel, as he is powerful enough that he can defeat the Organization even if it is a trap, and Rassimov agrees.

Fighting Wilder
Still unsettled by the visions of Arc, the Huntik team are all feeling down as they travel by boat to Medusa's Island. They arrive to discover Wilder. Hoffman and the Suits waiting on the beach. Wilder smugly reveals that with Stack infiltrating the Blood Spiral, he can control them from the inside. Realizing Wilder won't be convinced to help them fight the Spiral, Dante invokes Caliban to fight Venomaster and Myrmidon while Lok invokes Kipperin. While the rest of the team fights the Organization, Zhalia tracks down Stack, who leads Kiel and some Blood Spiral members to Medusa's Cave. She decides to report back to her team once she reaches the cave instead of infiltrating it.

Lok battles with Wilder but is sent crashing to ground when Kipperin is hit by a Weakenshade spell. Wilder sees an opportunity to get his hands on the Willblade but is interrupted by Dante. Wilder summons Incubane who fights Caliban and Sabriel. Cherit defeats Incubane with an energy blast while Lok and Dante hit Wilder together, defeating him. Reluctant to leave Stack and ruin their plan, Wilder angrily vows that they'll meet again some day before withdrawing with his men.

The plan is abruptly ruined however by Marduk and some Casterwill Hunters inside the cave who the team were unaware of. Lok summons Baselaird to fight off the Harlekins but they are isolated by Vulcana. Sophie recognizes Kiel as they fight while Dante tells Lok that it's up to him to finish the mission.

Baselaird defeats Vulcana by grabbing her so that he can hit her but her hot flames send him back his Amulet too. Zhalia's Thoughtspecter illusions give the team time to escape from Kiel who angrily knocks Stack unconscious and tells his men that they will return to Tantras.
